name: Finalize Production Infrastructure Topology
description: Decide final production deployment targets, DNS, TLS, CDN, and network boundaries. Acceptance: environment diagram + approved IaC/runbook committed.

name: Harden Environment and Secret Management
description: Move all production secrets to managed secret store and enforce rotation policy. Acceptance: no production secrets in repo/local files and rotation checklist tested.

name: Auth Security Hardening
description: Add email verification, password reset, and brute-force/rate-limiting controls. Acceptance: auth threat-model checklist passes and e2e auth tests pass.

name: Student Onboarding Flow (Real Users)
description: Complete registration, profile setup, welcome messaging, and first-course enrollment UX. Acceptance: new student can register, enroll, and access learning without manual intervention.

name: Tutor Onboarding and Profile Governance
description: Implement complete tutor onboarding, profile validation, and publishing controls. Acceptance: admin can approve tutor and tutor can publish approved course path.

name: RBAC and Permission Audit
description: Verify every admin/tutor/student route and API for least privilege. Acceptance: permission matrix documented and automated permission tests pass.

name: Course Lifecycle Completion
description: Enforce robust draft-to-review-to-publish-to-archive lifecycle with audit fields. Acceptance: all lifecycle transitions are validated and logged.

name: Enrollment and Access Consistency
description: Validate enrollment state against lesson/course access checks across frontend and backend. Acceptance: no unauthorized access and enrollment edge-case tests pass.

name: Billing Provider Integration (Stripe or Equivalent)
description: Implement checkout, webhook verification, payment status sync, and failure handling. Acceptance: test and live mode payment lifecycle works end-to-end.

name: Subscription, Invoicing, and Receipt Flow
description: Add plan management, invoice records, receipt delivery, and renewal/cancel handling. Acceptance: subscription events reconcile correctly in DB and user dashboard.

name: Refund and Charge Dispute Workflow
description: Define and implement admin workflows for refunds and disputes. Acceptance: documented process and tested admin UI/API flow.

name: Zoom Integration Foundation
description: Implement Zoom OAuth/app credentials and secure token storage/refresh. Acceptance: platform can create authenticated Zoom resources without manual token handling.

name: Live Class Scheduling via Zoom
description: Create tutor-driven Zoom session scheduling and student join-link delivery. Acceptance: tutor schedules class, students receive valid links, and metadata is persisted.

name: Attendance and Recording Sync (Zoom)
description: Sync Zoom attendance and recording metadata back to platform records. Acceptance: session attendance appears in dashboards/admin reporting.

name: Transactional Communications
description: Add email workflows: welcome, enrollment, payment receipt, class reminder, cancellation. Acceptance: templates, retries, and failure observability in place.

name: Admin KPI and Operational Dashboard
description: Replace placeholder admin panels with production KPIs (MRR, enrollments, conversion, churn, support load). Acceptance: metrics query real data and match KPI definitions.

name: Content Moderation and Abuse Reporting
description: Add report and moderation workflow for user-generated content and interactions. Acceptance: report-triage-action flow is audited and tested.

name: Security Controls and Compliance Baseline
description: Add WAF/rate limits, CSP and secure headers, dependency checks, and audit logging. Acceptance: security checklist pass and recurring scans integrated in CI.

name: Backup, Restore, and Disaster Recovery Drill
description: Formalize backup cadence and run restore drills with measured RPO/RTO. Acceptance: restore drill evidence for latest window is archived.

name: Observability and Alerting
description: Add log aggregation, metrics dashboards, SLO alerts, and on-call escalation paths. Acceptance: synthetic checks and alert routes verified.

name: Performance and Capacity Validation
description: Run load tests for browse, checkout, enroll, and lesson access paths. Acceptance: latency and error thresholds met at expected peak load.

name: QA Automation Expansion and Regression Gates
description: Expand integration/e2e coverage for payments, Zoom, onboarding, and admin ops. Acceptance: CI gates block merges on critical regression failures.

name: Staging UAT and Business Sign-Off
description: Execute staging smoke, role-flow, billing, and Zoom scripts with approvals. Acceptance: signed checklist and stakeholder approval recorded.

name: Legal, Policy, and User-Facing Trust Artifacts
description: Publish Terms, Privacy, Refund policy, and support/incident contact pathways. Acceptance: policy pages live and linked in onboarding/checkout.

name: Support and Incident Runbook Readiness
description: Define severity matrix, response SLA, and support triage workflow. Acceptance: support dry-run performed and documented.

name: Production Cutover and Launch Readiness Review
description: Execute final preflight, change freeze, launch checklist, and rollback simulation. Acceptance: launch review sign-off complete.

name: Post-Launch Stabilization Window Plan
description: Define first 14-day monitoring cadence and hotfix protocol. Acceptance: daily review ritual and owners assigned.
